note: Completes the removal of the Alexandria, Louisiana 1942 case: the three Black soldiers condemned to death by a civil court on a rape charge brought by a white complainant, scheduled to die on October 30, 1942, and reported by New Masses as a wartime legal lynching of servicemen. Batch 133 removed Bordenave alone because the curator had named only him; the curator has since asked for all three. He is listed here again so this script is the complete operation on its own — if batch 133 has already run he simply reports as absent, which is the same thing the script does on a second run of its own.
